summary: Keep one active Ontario Science Partners ProjectCo. Direct sources verify a 64% John Laing, 26% Sacyr Infrastructure Canada and 10% Amico Major Projects sponsor split at February 11, 2026 financial close. The 2021 takeover announcement expressly states that all future John Laing investments are fully KKR-owned while Equitix acquired 50% only of the pre-existing portfolio; Ontario Science Partners is therefore outside JLIL and Equitix. KKR is upstream of John Laing's 64%, not a fourth direct ProjectCo shareholder. Construction began in May 2026 and no later exit or pending transaction was found.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact KKR-owned John Laing legal entity holding the 64% is not publicly disclosed.
The legal name says General Partnership while the LEI legal-form code says Limited Partnership.
